dataset: Bio-AI Centre of Excellence — VedaVerse Plant Library
description: 100 entries: 25 Ayurvedic plants, 25 other medicinal plants and 50 culinary spices/herbs. Entries are educational drafts; review taxonomy, vernacular names, references and safety text before publication.
disclaimer: Educational reference only, not medical advice. Traditional use does not prove clinical effectiveness. Species identity, safety and claims should be reviewed by qualified botanists/health professionals before publication.

spices_board.name: Spices Board India – Spices of India list
